question: Can a Lomb-Scargle / autocorrelation peak-spacing prior estimate ω-magnitude within s005's 3-5% basin radius?
hypothesis: Peak-spacing on the LC produces an ω-mag estimate accurate enough (within ~3% basin radius) to seed LM polish.
narrative_md: Decisive negative. A Lomb-Scargle/ACF peak-spacing prior cannot hit s005's 3% ω-mag basin radius: blind dominant-peak median error 15.7% (worst 72.3%), even the truth-aware oracle median 7.4% (worst 17.2%). Tumbling rigid-body LCs are multi-periodic (precession + spin coupling), so the dominant peak does not track |ω| — peak/truth ratios scatter 0.14x-6.7x. The ω-mag-from-peak-spacing path is closed; Q4c must accept a coarse ω-mag grid or a model-aware prior.
